name: America First Credit Union
notes: Researched from public americafirst.com pages only (no sign-in). The bill is an America First loan payment. In digital banking, Transfer & Pay moves money from an America First account to the loan, or from another institution via External Transfers (Add a New Account); recurring transfers act as automatic payments. Other banks can push ACH using routing 324377516 and the loan's 12-digit electronic payment (ACH) number shown in online banking. Other channels: app, branch, ATM, staff-assisted phone transfer at 1-800-999-3961, mail to the P.O. Box with a payment coupon. Enrollment: one-time passcode, then create a user ID and password, verify account ownership and pick security questions; password/security questions are changed under Settings. Login MFA beyond enrollment is not documented, so the family default stays. Online statements are free, posted on the 5th, up to 7 years; paper is cancelled under Settings > Preferences > Statement Preferences. Skip-A-Payment costs $30 per skip (added to the loan) with $5 donated to the America First Charitable Foundation. No debit-card loan payment option was documented, so online methods are bank only (inferred). No public no-login payment page was found.

autopay.note: Automatic loan payments are recurring transfers set up in Transfer & Pay.

pay_by_phone.note: Staff transfer money from your America First checking or savings to the loan.

guest_pay.note: America First loans are paid by transfer in online or mobile banking after logging in, at a branch or ATM, by phone at 1-800-999-3961 or by mail; there is no pay-without-logging-in page.

payment_arrangement.note: America First has no online repayment plan. Qualifying loans can use Skip a Payment ($30) in online banking; otherwise call 1-800-999-3961 or visit a branch.

help.title: Making loan payments
paragraphs: No need to visit a branch or call: transfer money to your loan in America First online or mobile banking, and set up recurring transfers so payments are always on time.
From an America First account: log in, select Transfer & Pay, pick the account the money comes from and the loan that receives it, enter the amount and date, then review and submit.

From another financial institution: in Transfer & Pay choose External Transfers, tap Add a New Account if it is not already there, enter the other institution's information, the amount and date, then review and submit. Transfers started from the other bank need America First's routing number 324377516 and your loan's 12-digit electronic payment (ACH) number, which you can reveal in online banking with the unhide icon. Questions? Use online banking's secure chat or call 1-800-999-3961.
steps: Choose the from account and the America First loan.
Enter the amount and date, then review and submit.

help.title: Other ways to pay a loan
paragraphs: You can also pay at a branch, deposit cash or a check to the loan at an ATM, call 1-800-999-3961 to have staff transfer money from your checking or savings, or mail cash or a check to the P.O. Box with your name, account number and the loan it should go to. A Payment and Deposit Coupon works best.

help.title: Online statements
paragraphs: Online statements are free, ready on the fifth of every month, and you can review and print up to 7 years of them.
To stop paper statements, log in to digital banking, click Settings, select Preferences, go to Statement Preferences and follow the instructions.
steps: Open Statement Preferences and follow the instructions.

help.title: Sign up for online banking
paragraphs: Start enrollment from the online banking enroll page, confirm your identity with a one-time passcode, create a user ID and password, verify that you own the account, and choose security questions. After you log in, change your password or security questions in the Settings tab.

help.title: Skip-A-Payment
paragraphs: For $30 per skipped payment the Skip-a-Payment program lets you skip a qualifying loan payment, and America First donates $5 to its charitable foundation. Terms and conditions apply. To see whether your loan is eligible, log in to online banking and click Skip a Payment, visit a branch, or call 1-800-999-3961.

extra.intent: Using America First Credit Union's help pages, find the fee for skipping a qualifying loan payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
